overview: Chooses whether a character uses Cursed Energy or Physical Strength wording in battle and progression menus.

None.technical: Constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_CharacterUI::CharacterEnergyType and for both command-list energy parameters. The growth and interval screens replace a missing CharacterUI row with Cursed. Other traced consumers use a non-Physical test, so None would take the Cursed wording branch. No exported CharacterUI row uses this value.

Cursed.simple: The character uses Cursed Energy wording.
Cursed.technical: The CharacterUI row stores this value for 44 exported characters. Consumers show BTL_HUD_LABEL_0631 Cursed Energy Technique, BTL_HUD_LABEL_0710 Cursed Energy Increase, SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0049 Cursed Energy, and SYS_PVE_ENHANCEMET_LABEL_0202 Cursed Energy Extraction Increase. The command list uses character groups for its Cursed attack category, then copies the raw enum into FGameCommandListActionCursedEnergyParameter::EnergyType and FGameCommandListActionCostParameter::EnergyType. Cost widgets select SYS_COMMANDLIST_LABEL_0003 Cursed Energy Needed and SYS_COMMANDLIST_LABEL_0007 for the once-at-max condition. Several paths use Cursed as the explicit fallback when no CharacterUI row is found.

Physical.simple: The character uses Physical Strength wording.
Physical.technical: The CharacterUI export assigns this value to CP_060 and CP_200. Consumers show BTL_HUD_LABEL_0632 Cursed Tool Technique, BTL_HUD_LABEL_0711 Physical Strength Boost, SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0050 Physical Strength, and SYS_PVE_ENHANCEMET_LABEL_0203 Physical Strength Boost Increase. The command list selects ECategory::CursedEnergyAttack_Physical before its character-group tests and copies the raw enum into both command-list energy parameters. Cost widgets select SYS_COMMANDLIST_LABEL_0005 Physical Strength Needed and SYS_COMMANDLIST_LABEL_0008 for the once-at-max condition. Customize chat uses SYS_CUSTOMIZE_CHAT_LABEL_0002 Physical Strength Level Report.

Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 sentinel value 255. No exported CharacterUI row uses it and no explicit comparison was found. Generic non-Physical tests would take the Cursed wording branch, so no dedicated behavior is traced.

notes: FGameDataTableRow_CharacterUI stores the enum as uint8, and a damage-combo comment identifies it as row offset 0x10 with Physical equal to 2.
All traced consumers reduce the enum to a Physical test. Cursed, None, and Invalid share the non-Physical branch where no explicit fallback exists.
The supplied CharacterUI export has 44 Cursed rows and 2 Physical rows. CP_060 and CP_200 are the Physical rows. None and Invalid are absent.
Command-list energy parameters default to None, and the traced setup path overwrites them from the CharacterUI row before the action widgets read them.
